22.-16.0.rawName: Entrance to the City of Verminasia
22.-16.0.rawDesc:
You stand before a huge stone wall surrounding a city. On each corner
and above the gate are guard towers. The stone wall is massive and strong
to keep out unwanted visitors. The place is a virtual fortress, well
guarded by the alert sentries you see walking high in the towers. Massive
wooden gates, to the north, are currently open. It is odd you see no guards
at the gate.

22.-17.0.rawDesc:
You are standing inside the massive gates of the city of Verminasia. You
see a very busy city, but it looks like a slum from here. Hopefully it will  
get better further inside the city. Many unsavoury looking characters are 
walking around this area. Better watch your money closely.

22.-18.0.rawDesc:
You are on the southern end of Thieves Row. Looking around you can see this
part of Verminasia is a slum. Unsavoury people of the worst kind wander the 
streets, day and night. It would be a good idea to keep your weapons and
gold close to your body, or better yet, well hidden.

22.-19.0.rawDesc:
This is the northern end of Thieves Row.  To the north is a bridge
crossing a swift river that divides the two areas of Verminasia.  To the
south is more Thieves Row and the well guarded southern gates to the city. 
To the west is a small building with a sign that reads  [1;32mM[0;32muju's [1;32mM[0;32mojo [1;32mS[0;32mhop[0m.

22.-20.0.rawDesc:
Drakkara bridge, named after the evil goddess of magic herself, is a proud
landmark of the city. It is a massive bridge of stone and wood, and is very
well maintained throughout the year. The slight arch of the bridge gives a
good view of the city on both sides. The fast flowing river rumbles below
as you gaze at the city.

22.-21.0.rawDesc:
You are standing at an intersection called Southern Square. North is Royal
Avenue. Sabre Street is west and Esquire Parkway is east. To the south is
the famous bridge landmark, Drakkara Bridge.

22.-22.0.rawDesc:
This is the south end of Royal Avenue. The tree-lined street is a short walk
north, to the busier section of town, or south, to the park area. A few 
stores are nestled among the trees.

22.-23.0.rawDesc:
As the well-maintained roads direct the way into the the heart of
Verminasia they open into an expansive, octagonal square just south of the
fortress-like temple and palace of Verminasia.  Framed on all sides by
elegant covered walkways, Guillotine square occupies the rise of a hill
within the city center, bisected by Guillotine Road to the east and west and
the Royal Avenue travelling north and south.  The focal point of the square
is it's namesake guillotine, an instrument of grim reprisal that stands atop
a broad dreadwood platform, giving all within the square ample view of these
special occasions.  The square functions as the civic center of the city, a
place where both the noble; families and low-born congregate or travel
through to the city's many religious and historic sites.  The iconic
language of the dark city's history is told through use of [1;30mstatuaries[0m and
[1;30mcarving[0m beneath the porticoes and by the inlaid granite [1;30mmosaic[0m of the
square.  The towering Karecus arena rises up to the southeast of the square,
beckoning combatants and spectators alike with promises of bloodshed and
glory.

22.-24.0.rawDesc:
You are walking on a tree lined street.  To the south, is Guillotine
Square and Royal Avenue continues southward.  To the north, is the Temple
and Unholy Grounds of the City of Verminasia.  Looking east is the side of
the Royal Arms Inn building.  To the west lies "The Toy Box Shop" and to the
east lies "Dark Forge Armory".

22.-25.0.rawDesc:
You are in a beautiful courtyard that is surrounded by greenery and has a
large fountain in its center.  Before you is a massive, black temple made
entirely of obsidian, its size imposing and awe-inspiring.  Evil eminates
from the temple, and you are certain of one thing - you have entered the
holy grounds of the city of Verminasia.

22.-26.0.rawDesc:
You are standing at the entrance to the temple. Enormous black obsidian
pillars stand on each side of the entrance. Dramatic carvings of dark
gods cover the pillars. Above the doorway are carvings of famous battles
and victories of Verminasia.

22.-27.0.rawDesc:
You are in a huge cavernous room that leads to all other rooms in the temple.
A massive black altar sits in the middle of the room to worship the dark and
evil gods. The altar is carved from a mysterious black stone that's cold as
ice to the touch. At the base of the altar is a black slab covered with the
blood of a recent sacrifice. The altar also holds various gifts and offerings
from true followers to assist those less fortunate on their way to glorify
and further the cause of the truely great gods.

21.-27.0.rawDesc:
The king himself had this room built for the powerful priestess Zerrella.
A faithful servant to the king and a strong believer in the evil gods, she
uses her powers of healing to all who enter her domain wounded and injured.
The room has statues and wall decorations honoring heros and knights that
have been touched by Zerrella's hands.

21.-28.0.rawDesc:
You are in a huge room filled with benches for a large mass of people. On the
north wall is a massive statue of the God of all Evil, Necrucifer. Surrounding
him are smaller statues of the lesser evil gods who have their own followers.
This room is used for special, momentous occasions, such as the acceptance or
honoring of a knight in the service of the King, or a couple wishing the bond
of holy matrimony, blessed by Necrucifer himself. All of Verminasia believes
if you make a vow, or honor someone in this room, that Necrucifer himself
will bless and acknowledge that honor and vow. It is also believed that any
who try to break that blessing would have punishment of unheard horror to haunt
them the rest of their days.

22.-28.0.rawDesc:
The room of Holy Wars has a special place in the history of Verminasia.
Knights and warriors come here to be blessed and protected on their way
to avenge and defend the honor of their fallen heroes. The king himself and
the leader of Eclipse, as well as many powerful Knights of Eclipse have been
seen here. Those lucky enough to have been present at these times are awed by
the powerful clan who give their life to the king and promote evil as the
truly honorable way of life.

23.-28.0.rawDesc:
A small unassuming room to welcome visitors. A good place for a cleric to
relax from the rigorous training, and visit family and friends.

23.-27.0.rawDesc:
The room of prayer is open to all to come to worship the evil ones, but to
also worship a particular god, the one they chose to worship as their own
personal guide to help them along in their mortal life. Some come here to
ask for favors of a particular god, during a crisis in their life, or a vow
of revenge, or honor, and want the help of that god. You see clanners and
townspeople alike kneeling and bowed before the statue of the God of their
choice.

21.-23.0.rawDesc:
Guillotine Road continues east and west. Eastward is the famous Guillotine 
Square where the town gathers for executions of their enemies. North is a
gem store. To the south is an exclusive ladies shop catering to the wealthy.

20.-23.0.rawDesc:
Guillotine Road is a busy main street. North you see a high class dining
establishment. High ranking couples from the palace are seen going in and
out of there. East and west Guillotine Road continues. Sweet smells come
from the south.

19.-23.0.rawDesc:
East and west Guillotine Road continues. North is the entrance to the Mage's
Guild. South is a shop of selling magical items. You see knights, and nobles
strolling along this street. Ladies in waiting, loaded down with packages,
follow their mistresses from shop to shop.

18.-23.0.rawDesc:
You are on the west end of Guillotine Road. To the west is the tower city
gates. Eastward Guillotine Road continues. A small shop to the north has
no name and looks oddly different from the busy stores on the rest of the
street. To the south is a potion and herbal shop. Looking farther east, you
see a large Guillotine overshadowing a town square.

17.-23.0.rawDesc:
This is the western tower gate entrance to the city of Verminasia. 
Guards are permanantly stationed here checking people going in and out of
the city.  East is Guillotine Road, a very busy main street by the looks of
the people strolling from shop to shop.  South is a back alley.  


To the north, a magnificently round architectural construct stands, built in
a striking combination of black and deep red marble, A series of smaller
archways encircle the building, each one framed by wrought iron gates that
stand open to allow entrance in or exit out.  At its center, stands the
grandest archway of all with intricate designs inlaid with gold.  The
amphitheater is an impressive show of elegant beauty and extreme wealth - a
true dark jewel.

16.-23.0.rawName: A Dusty Trail Leading to the West Gates of a City
16.-23.0.rawDesc:
You stand before a huge stone wall that circles a city. On each corner
and above the gates are guard towers. The stone wall is massive and strong
to keep out unwanted visitors. The city is a virtual fortress, well guarded
by the alert sentries you see walking high in the towers. Massive wooden
gates to the east are currently open. Several guards patrol the gates
checking visitors going in and out of the city. A dusty trail continues
north and south, following the wall and leading into a dark forest.

15.-23.0.rawName: A Dusty Trail near a Stone Wall
15.-23.0.rawDesc:
You are walking on a small trail that is near a massive stone wall
surrounding a large city.  The western gates lie toward the east.  The trail
continues northward and southward.
